summary: Gaps from the first consumer app. README Quick start: Tailwind v4 needs no @source for installed items in a standard app — its scanner reads the project root and skips only node_modules and git-ignored paths, and CLI targets (src/ui, src/lib, src/hooks) are inside it (measured with Tailwind 4.3.5's scanner: all 40 installed files found without the consumer's three @source lines); @source is documented only for git-ignored install folders, sources outside the root and a narrowed source(). README also documents the eslint-preset and the visual-review/app-motion skills. Authoring skills: ui-demo-page gains three traps (nested .t-acc descendant selector, digit-swap debris in DOM text, a 0.5px border adding height on a fixed row); design-component §7 gains asset export through tool calls when the asset host is blocked (Paper get_jsx for SVG nodes, Figma use_figma + exportAsync SVG_STRING, rasters cropped from a saved get_screenshot); review-ui points at the visual-review method for comparing against design exports. Adds .github/pull_request_template.md.

migration.manual: Optional: an app whose @source lines point at src/ui, src/lib or src/hooks inside its own root, not git-ignored, can delete them; keep them if any of the three README cases applies.
